name: FUN_BAL_RECON_RESULT
description: This table contains the total intercompany receivables and payables balance for a given ledger and accounting period. This information is used to display the Intercompany Balances Infolet.

columns.name: ESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the intercompany reconciliation data extract job that created the row.

columns.name: FROM_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: From ledger identifier of intercompany reconciliation.

columns.name: TO_LEDGER_ID
columns.description: To ledger identifier of intercompany reconciliation.

columns.name: FROM_LE_ID
columns.description: From legal entity identifier of intercompany reconciliation.

columns.name: TO_LE_ID
columns.description: To legal entity identifier of intercompany reconciliation.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency of the provider ledger in which the balances are stored.

columns.name: AP_PTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payables period to date balance between the legal entities.

columns.name: AR_PTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Receivables period to date balance between the legal entities.

columns.name: AP_YTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Payables year to date balance between the legal entities.

columns.name: AR_YTD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Receivables year to date balance between the legal entities.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
